content.comment_body: Hello. If I change a parameter in any function using [product_name] engineering software, the program on the device also updates. After making such changes, I'm unable to run the online test. To resolve this, I need to compare and update the function values in my offline project, and only then is the online test possible. Does anyone know why this happens?

When you adjust parameter values via the web server, you're changing only the values in the device and not in the engineering software. If you then attempt an online test, the parameters in the device won't match those in your offline program, which causes the online test to fail.
Yes, that's correct—the engineering software is just for configuration purposes. Does this mean there's no way to remotely update parameters and have them synchronized automatically?

I'm not sure I fully understand your question. You can indeed change parameter values on the device via the web server or remotely, but those updates only affect the values stored on the device, not in your engineering software project on your PC. So, when you change parameters remotely, the versions on the device and in your offline project no longer match, which prevents online testing. Does this explanation help clarify?
In that case, when you try to perform an online test and get this message, you will need to download the program from the device to your engineering software before trying the online test again.

Hi, you can also change parameters during an online test. Select the function block you want to update, right-click, and choose 'Remote properties.' This allows you to modify parameters directly while online.

Development method: • Download your program to the device • Activate Online Test • Change parameters Alternatively: • Download to the device • Change parameters • Upload the program to the engineering software • Activate Online Test Diagnostics: • Upload the program to the engineering software • Activate Online Test • Troubleshooting: I recommend backing up the project. For diagnostics, instead of loading the project files, upload the current device program to the engineering software and activate the Online Test. That's my workflow.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter workflow issues when modifying parameters either via remote access or engineering software. Changes made directly on the device aren't automatically reflected in the offline project, leading to mismatches that prevent online diagnostics. This causes inefficiency and confusion about the synchronization process of such changes.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect automatic synchronization of parameter changes between their device and engineering software, seeking a smooth workflow that allows for immediate online testing after remote updates—without needing manual uploads or downloads.
